message.name: StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactionsCancellationV02
message.definition: Scope|An account servicer, for example, a transfer agent sends the StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactionsCancellation message to the account owner, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative to cancel a previously sent StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactions message.|Usage|The StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactionsCancellation message is used to cancel a previously sent StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactions message. This message must contain the reference of the message to be cancelled.|This message may also contain all the details of the message to be cancelled, but this is not recommended.

rules.name: StreetNameAndOrPostOfficeBoxRule
rules.text: If StreetName is not present, then PostOfficeBox is mandatory. If StreetName is present, then PostOfficeBox is optional.

rules.name: RoleOrExtendedRoleRule
rules.text: Either Role or ExtendedRole may be present, but not both.

rules.name: TypeOrExtendedTypeRule
rules.text: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.

rules.name: TypeOrExtendedTypeRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.

rules.name: TransactionTypeLegIdentificationRule
rules.text: If TransactionType is SWII or SWIO, then LegIdentification is optional. If TransactionType is neither SWII nor SWIO, then LegIdentification is not allowed.

rules.name: TransactionTypeLegExecutionIdentificationRule
rules.text: If TransactionType is SWII or SWIO, then LegExecutionIdentification is optional. If TransactionType is neither SWII nor SWIO, then LegExecutionIdentification is not allowed.

rules.name: TransactionTypeOrCorporateActionEventTypeRule
rules.text: Either TransactionType or ExtendedTransactionType or CorporateActionEventType or ExtendedCorporateActionEventType must be present but not more than one.

rules.name: TransactionTypeOrCorporateActionEventTypeRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either TransactionType or ExtendedTransactionType or CorporateActionEventType or ExtendedCorporateActionEventType must be present but not more than one.

rules.name: TransactionTypeOrCorporateActionEventTypeRuleNotBoth2
rules.text: Either TransactionType or ExtendedTransactionType or CorporateActionEventType or ExtendedCorporateActionEventType must be present but not more than one.

rules.name: TransactionTypeOrCorporateActionEventTypeRuleNotBoth3
rules.text: Either TransactionType or ExtendedTransactionType or CorporateActionEventType or ExtendedCorporateActionEventType must be present but not more than one.

rules.name: FirstOpeningBalanceOrIntermediaryOpeningBalanceRule
rules.text: Either FirstOpeningBalance or IntermediaryOpeningBalance may be present, but not both.

rules.name: FinalClosingBalanceOrIntermediaryClosingBalanceRule
rules.text: Either FinalClosingBalance or IntermediaryClosingBalance may be present, but not both.

rules.name: TransactionOnSubAccountRule
rules.text: If ActivityIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TransactionOnSubAccount must be present. If ActivityIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then TransactionOnSubAccount is not allowed.

rules.name: ExtensionRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of the Registration Authority and without strict usage rules published by the Registration Authority.

rules.name: TransactionOnAccountOrSubAccountDetailsRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then either TransactionOnAccount or SubAccountDetails must be present. If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then TransactionOnAccount and SubAccountDetails are not allowed.
